checked: Internal consistency: name, signed 1864-10-18, ratified 1866-05-22, proclaimed 1866-08-16, citation, textUrl, promises and ICC sources all concern the October 18, 1864 treaty; the 1855 date appears only in the openQuestion flagging treaties.json.

Statutes at Large, 14 Stat. 657 (govinfo): treaty concluded Oct. 18, 1864, ratification advised with amendments May 22, 1866, proclaimed Aug. 16, 1866. 14 Stat. 637 is an unrelated private act, so OSU's 637 is a misprint.
ICC Docket 13-H opinion (524) and findings (354), May 14, 1953: no fraud in the 1864 treaty; timber claim too vague to support recovery.
Ziibiwing history page: delayed annuities, lumbermen swindles, agents and timber barons, 130,000 acres, 1,500 allotments, a handful by 1934, 2010 boundary ruling, as attributed.
